quote: Stevo Todorčević posed the Open Coloring Axiom in 1989 in 'Partition Problems in Topology'
note: OCA was introduced by Todorčević in 1989. The specific consistency question (whether OCA is consistent with 2^ℵ₀ > ℵ₂) was part of the original problem formulation by Todorčević in the same work. This remains an open problem.
